points.text: Quebec-based NANUK designs and manufactures protective hard cases, with corporate roots going back to plastic box production that began in 1984
Many cases carry an IP67 rating and use NK-7 resin, serving photography, drone, medical, military, industrial and outdoor users
The company has expanded into bags, organizers and coolers, and its N-PVD ecosystem won a 2024 Red Dot Design Award

points.text: Larch Wood Canada, founded in 2003 in Margaree, Nova Scotia, handcrafts end-grain cutting boards and other products from Eastern Canadian larch

Sales have expanded to Toronto, Montreal and the U.S., with a decade-plus Williams-Sonoma partnership and boards sold at Sur La Table
